        result = np.divide(a, b)
        result[np.isinf(result)] = replace_inf_with
        result[np.isnan(result)] = replace_inf_with
    return result

def _get_numpy_array_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if use_log_scale:
        num1_log = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num1)
        num2_log = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num2)
        distances = np.abs(num1_log - num2_log)
        distances = np.where(distances < log_scale_similarity_threshold, 0, distances)
    else:
        divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_
        distances = np.abs(num1 - num2)
        distances = _numpy_div(distances, divisor, replace_inf_with=max_)
        distances = np.minimum(distances, max_)
    return distances
